families.name: FIRST_READ
families.coverage: Synchronous and asynchronous first MoveNext, enumerator creation and deferred Current failures.

families.name: LATER_READ
families.coverage: Later synchronous and asynchronous MoveNext and deferred Current failures after an earlier valid chunk.

families.name: DEFERRED_PROPERTY
families.coverage: Deferred Current, source chunk-property and async enumerator boundary failures, including cleanup combinations.

families.name: READ_CLEANUP_COMBINATIONS
families.coverage: Primary read failures combined with synchronous or asynchronous disposal failures.

families.name: DISPOSAL
families.coverage: Early disposal, normal-completion disposal failures and successful exact-once disposal.

families.name: OPEN_CANCELLATION
families.coverage: OpenSchema, wrapped provider, row-source and query-scoped row-source cancellation paths.

families.name: READ_CANCELLATION
families.coverage: Synchronous and asynchronous first, later and deferred-Current cancellation paths.

families.name: CLEANUP_CANCELLATION
families.coverage: Cancellation during normal, read-failure, token-canceled and early cleanup paths.

contract.verificationResult: 48/48 cases verified before observation and again before completion.

initialObservations.finding: Async GetAsyncEnumerator failures escaped as raw IOException; eight read-plus-cleanup cases omitted relatedCauseType; and a canceled async token with regular cleanup was translated to MQ7012.

focusedReplay.coverage: The permanent matrix exercises all 48 frozen identifiers, safe read/cleanup cause facts, exact cancellation identity where injected, token cancellation precedence and exact-once disposal.

productionFindings.description: The async enumerator-creation boundary was outside the MQ7011 read envelope; cleanup failures were silently discarded after a primary read envelope; and regular async cleanup failure overrode a canceled token.
productionFindings.repair: Wrap async enumerator creation as MQ7011 while preserving OperationCanceledException, attach only the related exception type to the primary lifecycle diagnostic, preserve cleanup cancellation, and skip cleanup when no enumerator was created.
productionFindings.initialEvidence: The preserved 37/48 baseline replay observed the three failure classes before repair.

obligations.REC-128-O01: The 48-case matrix injects first-read, later-read, deferred Current/source-property, async enumerator and disposal failures.
obligations.REC-128-O02: Eight combined read-plus-cleanup cases retain MQ7011 as the primary diagnostic, expose relatedCauseType=System.IO.IOException and omit provider secret text.
obligations.REC-128-O03: Eighteen open/read/cleanup cancellation cases preserve injected OperationCanceledException identity or preserve a canceled async token over regular cleanup.
obligations.REC-128-O04: All opened enumerators are disposed exactly once; creation/property failures perform no phantom disposal, successful completion has no exception and no failure path reports fabricated success.
obligations.acceptance: Lifecycle failure combinations have deterministic contract-backed precedence.

notes: The pre-repair replay is preserved under .campaign-artifacts/REC-128-focused-initial-r4; no frozen expectation was changed after observation.
The focused final replay and adjacent suites ran before the authoritative full gate; the source and test payload was unchanged after the gate.
The Release gate includes the three established generated-code refresh skips from REC-085-skip-allowlist.json.
